headers.comment: Vite content-hashes everything under /assets, so a changed file is a changed URL. These can be cached forever and never revalidated.
public/ files keep their names across deploys, so 'immutable' would pin an edited texture in returning players' caches. A week, then revalidate in the background.

redirects.comment: One canonical hostname, matching the canonical link tag. Inert unless the www domain is actually attached to the project.
